summary: Frontend-only validation of VETMECH pricing/offer engine + cart replace fix. Logged in via OTP as 9000000123 (dev_otp returned in response and displayed on UI). On /products/vetkclor (100 ml Bottle variant, base ₹100), verified that exactly ONE offer is marked 'Applied' per quantity and matches the lowest-net-rate rule: qty=10 -> 'Buy 10 Get 5' (2+1) Applied, net ₹66.67; qty=22 -> 'Buy 22 Get 13' Applied, net ₹62.86; qty=36 -> '2+1' Applied, net ₹66.67 (correctly beats the ₹85 slab); qty=72 -> 'Buy 22 Get 13' Applied, net ₹64.86. Applied offer visually highlighted (green border + Applied badge) and non-applied offers dim. Ratio simplification confirmed on product page: 'Buy 10 Get 5' renders as '2+1 - buy 2, get 1 free'. data-testid net-rate present and shows '+X% GST' note plus (base x qty div total) breakdown. Cart REPLACE bug fixed: adding qty 10 then qty 36 for the same VKC-100 results in a single line at qty 36 (not 46), with Free=18, Dispatch=54, Net Rate ₹66.67 +12% GST (data-testid cart-netrate-VKC-100). Guest view on the same product hides prices/offers and shows 'Login to View Your Prices' card with MRP-only display (no ₹100 leaked, 0 offers rendered).
critical_code_review_comments: OTP request rate limiter is quite aggressive (blocked repeat login attempts within ~2 min window). Not a bug but consider per-mobile+IP cooldown message with retry-after seconds to improve UX during automated testing and legitimate re-sends.

Quick Order simplified offer chips regression could not be re-verified in this run due to OTP rate limit after multiple logins; ProductDetail already uses simplifyRatio and renders 2+1 correctly. Main agent can self-verify on /quick-order once rate limit clears.
Consider adding a data-testid on the 'Applied' badge itself (e.g. offer-applied-badge) so tests don't rely on class or text matching.
